facts.fact: The Citizen reports mandatory SIM card registration in Tanzania uses fingerprints and National Identification Authority details, under procedures set by the communications regulator TCRA.

TZA.note: No civil register link to the ID system is mentioned.
No count or share of people holding a national ID is given.
No number given at birth is mentioned.
Who operates, maintains or owns the ID system is not stated.
SIM registration is not a public register keyed on the ID number.
Fingerprints are used in SIM registration, but no biometric check by the ID system itself is stated.

facts.fact: The Citizen reports mobile operators Yas, Airtel, TTCL and Halotel register SIM cards using fingerprints and National Identification Authority details, and on 18 November 2026 the Home Affairs Minister ordered SIMs not linked to NIDA deactivated.
